evidence.detail: @APP.route and @SEASONS.route exist for '/decks/<any(tournament,league):deck_type>/' — the singular /tournament/ URL works but plural /tournaments/ would 404
People routes (/people/, /people/<username>/, etc.) have no deck_type parameter — /people/tournaments/ and /people/<user>/tournaments/ do not exist

Owner comment: 'a pretty broad set of changes needed to switch from an ad hoc leagueOnly/tournamentOnly world to one where every page can have /tournament/ or /league/ appended'; mentions UI redesign for the toggle and React-driven deck_type state

triage.notes: The singular /seasons/<id>/decks/tournament/ URL already works today via existing SEASONS routes. The open work is: (1) people pages need deck_type support, (2) API calls need threading, (3) the plural-vs-singular URL naming should be resolved, (4) UI toggle should be redesigned. This is multi-controller scope.
